opsproc.title: Aft cabin attendant seat required for direct view inoperative, requiring an additional cabin attendant

inform.para: The number of cabin attendants required by the operational requirements is 1 cabin attendant per 50 passenger seats or fraction of 50 passenger seats. They are seated on operative CAS. The additional cabin attendant seated on a passenger seat cannot be counted in the required cabin attendants.

procitem.title: Procedure to be developed in the operator's MEL

inform.para: Alternate procedures must be established before departure according to regulations:

item.para: for the cabin attendant displaced in a non-required Cabin Attendant Seat,
for the additional cabin attendant assigned to a passenger seat to ensure direct view.
